verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents trait-based targeting (geography, plan, device, app version) and segments, which are groups of users matching trait-based rules. Flags can be overridden for every user in a segment, percentage rollouts can run within a segment, and multivariate flags can serve different variations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of reusing one segment across multiple flags, detail on rule operators and condition logic, independent or hands-on corroboration of segment targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: Target features to users with specific traits (such as geography, subscription level, device type, or application version).
Define segments—groups of users matching rules based on traits (e.g., location, plan, app version, usage). Override feature flags for all users in a segment.
Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, either globally or within a segment.
Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).
